messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} why don't you
and I go look for fossils
together, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Just follow me,{01 00 00 05 00} because
I know the perfect spot!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} miks me ei lähe
koos fossiile otsima,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Järgne lihtsalt mulle,{01 00 00 05 00} sest
ma tean täiuslikku kohta!

messages.en:
I'm starting to think I've
been talking to {ff 00 00 06}Blathers{ff 00 00 00}
too much.
{07 14 00}He's gotten me all excited
about going out and digging
up some fossils{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
I know! {07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, would
you like to come too,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
Ma hakkan arvama, et ma
olen {ff 00 00 06}Blathersiga{ff 00 00 00} liiga
palju rääkinud.
{07 14 00}Ta on mind elevile ajanud
fossiilide
kaevamisest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Ma tean! {07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa
tahaksid ka kaasa tulla,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 0f 00}It looks easy, but I can't
find any fossils.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 16 00} It's not
supposed to be so hard!
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you have to
help me find a fossil!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Pleeeeease, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0f 00}See näib lihtne, aga ma ei
leia ühtegi fossiili.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 16 00} See ei
peaks nii raske olema!
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa pead mind
aitama fossiili leida!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Paaaalun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Hmmmmm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 16 00}It's hard work,
digging up fossils,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}I wish someone would bury
one for me and tell me
where it is, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Hmmmmm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00} Raske töö,
fossiilide kaevamine,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Soovin, et keegi mataks ühe
mulle maha ja ütleks, kus
see on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Even once you've found a
fossil, don't go digging like
a madman, {04 1f 00}!
{07 00 00}Fossils are very fragile,{01 00 00 0f 00}
like poor {04 01 00}. You
have to treat them gently.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Isegi kui sa oled fossiili
leidnud, ära kaeva nagu
hullumeelne, {04 1f 00}!
{07 00 00}Fossiilid on väga habrased,{01 00 00 0f 00}
nagu vaene {04 01 00}. Sa
pead neid õrnalt kohtlema.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, did you
remember to eat your
lunch, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}When I'm out hunting for
dinosaur bones and stuff, I
lose track of time.
{07 06 00}One time, I got so hungry
that I started gnawing on a
bone I'd dug up!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa
mäletasid lõunat
süüa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Kui ma jahin dinosauruste
luid ja kraami, kaotan ma
ajataju.
{07 06 00}Kord oli mul nii kõht tühi,
et ma hakkasin närima
väljakaevatud luud!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm worn out from digging
all day, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0e 00}Maybe I should go home and
make myself a hot cup
of {04 13 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma olen kaevamisest terve
päeva väsinud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0e 00}Ehk peaksin ma koju minema
ja endale kuuma tassi
{04 13 00} tegema{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Once it gets dark, it can
be pretty tough to find
any fossils, {07 15 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
I should go to bed soon{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 06 00}But what if I'm just about
to find the perfect fossil?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kui pimedaks läheb, võib
olla üsna raske leida
fossiile, {07 15 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Peaksin varsti magama{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 06 00}Aga mis siis, kui ma olen
kohe leidmas täiuslikku?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, do you want to
join me for a little fossil
hunting, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
It can be slow work, and I'd
love to have a little
company while I dig around.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa tahad
minuga natuke fossiile
jahtida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
See võib olla aeglane töö ja
ma tahaksin natuke seltsi,
kui ma ringi kaevan.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Fossils are the remains of
creatures that lived
thousands of years ago{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
For me, {07 13 00}digging up fossils
is like digging up chunks of
history, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Fossiilid on olendite
jäänused, kes elasid
tuhandeid aastaid tagasi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Minu jaoks on {07 13 00}fossiilide
kaevamine nagu ajaloo
tükkide kaevamine,{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Hmmmmmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm starting to
think there's nothing
here.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you'll let me
know if you find anything,
won't you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}You'd think there'd be some
kind of mark where a fossil
is buried, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Hmmmmm.{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma hakkan arvama,
et siin pole
midagi.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa annad mulle
teada, kui midagi leiad,
kas pole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Võiks arvata, et seal, kus
fossiil on maetud, oleks
mingi märk, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
